50201.text: I) Unlawful seizure of an aircraft II) Damage to an aircraft in service III) Hostage-taking on board an aircraft or at an aerodrome IV) Forcible unauthorised entry onto an aircraft, an aerodrome, or the facilities of an aerodrome V) Introduction aboard an aircraft or into an aerodrome of a weapon, dangerous device or material for malicious purposes. Which of the above is/are among acts of unlawful interference?
options: I, II, III, IV and V

50202.text: "…………" is a person working in the aviation sector who assists a terrorist organisation for various motivations. Which of the following should fill the blank?
options: A passenger posing a potential threat

50203.text: What is the term for persons who disrupt order and discipline at an aerodrome or on an aircraft by failing to comply with the rules or with the instructions of aerodrome personnel or cabin crew?

50204.text: The difficulty in predicting what kind of act individuals will carry out because of how they move, and their next actions, relates to which characteristic of individual threats?

50205.text: I) Appropriate Authority II) Airport Security Committee III) Local Authority IV) Training, Research and Audit Unit. According to Annex 17 to the Chicago Convention, which of the above must the national organisation include at a minimum?

50206.text: Which of the following has as its main purpose the regulation of the duties, powers and responsibilities of the institutions and organisations responsible for protecting the public, passengers, crew, ground personnel, and airport buildings and facilities against all kinds of unlawful acts that could occur on the ground or in the air against civil aviation, and the determination of the principles of implementation?
options: National Civil Aviation Security Training Programme

50207.text: Which of the following is correct regarding the ICAO Annex 17 security regulation?
options: It has been drafted quite briefly and concisely
It is very detailed and comprehensive
It has been drawn up as an addition to the Tokyo Convention
It contains all civil aviation regulations
It contains detailed recommendations on implementation details

50208.text: Which convention covers the use of explosive devices against civil aviation?
options: Convention for the Suppression of Unlawful Acts against the Safety of Civil Aviation (Montreal Convention)
Convention on Offences and Certain Other Acts Committed on Board Aircraft (Tokyo Convention)
Convention for the Suppression of Unlawful Seizure of Aircraft (Hague Convention)
Convention on International Civil Aviation (Chicago Convention)
Convention on the Marking of Plastic Explosives (MEX Convention)

50209.text: Which convention grants authority to persons responsible for an aircraft in the event of acts that disrupt order or discipline on board?
options: Convention on Offences and Certain Other Acts Committed on Board Aircraft (Tokyo Convention)
Convention for the Suppression of Unlawful Acts against the Safety of Civil Aviation (Montreal Convention)
Convention for the Suppression of Unlawful Seizure of Aircraft (Hague Convention)
Convention on the Marking of Plastic Explosives (MEX Convention)
Convention on International Civil Aviation (Chicago Convention)

50210.text: I) It must be established and implemented. II) It must be a written document. III) It contains measures for the protection of civil aviation against unlawful acts. IV) An appropriate authority is designated who is responsible for the development of the programme and for ensuring coordination of the duties and services specified within it. Which of the above is/are correct for the National Civil Aviation Security Programme?

50211.text: Which of the following is not among the duties of the National Civil Aviation Security Committee?
options: Carrying out audits, tests and inspections at airports
Making recommendations on aviation security measures against threats to aviation
Considering ways of cooperating with international organisations and other states to improve the security of civil aviation as a whole
Ensuring the coordination of aviation security measures among the institutions and other organisations responsible for implementing the National Civil Aviation Security Programme
Promoting security considerations in the design of new airports or in the expansion of existing facilities

50212.text: In which of the following is the required structure of the national organisation in the field of aviation security regulated?

50213.text: Which of the following is the organisation responsible for the development, implementation and continuity of the National Civil Aviation Security Programme?

50214.text: Which of the following is correct regarding the airport security committee within the national aviation security structure?
options: It is established separately for each airport and operates at the local level
Its duties are limited solely to passenger security
It is established only at international airports
It is responsible for technical maintenance and flight planning
It operates directly under the airport security authority

50215.text: Who is the local authority responsible for airport security?
options: Director of the Directorate of Migration Management

50216.text: What is the term for areas to which access is granted with a valid entry document and a security check?

50217.text: Which of the following is not one of the rules that a person holding an entry card must comply with?
options: Admitting unauthorised guests or visitors into the areas for which they are responsible
Using the entry card only for the areas for which it is authorised
Allowing officials at security checkpoints to examine the airport entry card, compare it with the photograph, and check the authorised areas
Being subject to screening at checkpoints, since the entry card alone does not provide exemption
Not giving their card to someone else to use

50218.text: I) The vehicle entry permit must be specific to the vehicle. II) The permit document must state the areas for which entry is permitted. III) The permit document must state an expiry date. IV) The permit document must state the driver's details. Which of the above information regarding vehicle entry permits is/are correct?

50219.text: What is the term for the authorisation check carried out to prevent unauthorised persons and vehicles from entering the airside and security restricted areas?

50220.text: What is the term for the parts of an airport beyond the "access control" point, which not everyone may enter, and which only passengers and authorised personnel may enter?

50221.text: Which of the following cannot be shown among the benefits of an effective security culture?
options: Ensuring that security is improved through major expenditure
An increased likelihood of employees identifying and reporting concerning behaviour/activities
Employees engaging with security issues and taking responsibility
Ensuring that employees feel a greater sense of security
An increase in the level of compliance with security measures

50222.text: Which of the following is not among the responsibilities that must be fulfilled by managers in order to develop a security culture within organisations?
options: Compromising on aviation security during periods of economic difficulty
Making aviation security a core value that is reflected across the whole institution/organisation
Always complying with the established rules on aviation security and setting an example
Encouraging constructive feedback regarding security incidents
Continuously promoting and supporting the importance of security measures

50223.text: I) Leaflets and posters emphasising the importance of security measures II) Using e-learning tools III) Internal communication platforms such as intranet, newsletters and videos IV) Using digital media. Which of the above are among the awareness campaigns to be carried out by institutions/organisations to develop a security culture?

50224.text: What is the term for the situation that arises because institutions/organisations operating in the aviation field, and their employees, lack knowledge of, or awareness about, aviation security and potential security threats?

50225.text: Which of the following is not among the benefits of an effective security culture?
options: An increase in the risk of security incidents occurring as employees act with greater security awareness
An increased likelihood of employees identifying and reporting suspicious behaviour
Security being improved without the need for major expenditure
An increase in the level of compliance with security measures
Employees engaging with security issues and taking responsibility
